work: Claude Debussy, Suite bergamasque L. 75, III. Clair de lune (published 1905)
source: The Mutopia Project, piece 1778, typeset in LilyPond 2.12.3 from the E. Fromont (1905) edition
license: Public Domain (Mutopia; the typesetter placed the edition in the public domain, Creative Commons Public Domain Dedication). The composition is public domain (Debussy d. 1918).
use: Bars 1-8 are arranged for the coastal memory's broken music box by tools/chunk_surfer/build-music-box-arrangement.mjs into src/data/clair-de-lune-music-box.js. No recording is used; the box is synthesized.
